Boundaries.Name: native-raw-admission
Boundaries.Contract: Immediate admission transfers final ownership directly to the native raw response. Rejected admission reclaims the unpublished source and retains the logical dispatch owner on fallback. Pre-admission failures publish only after reclaiming the source. No cache fence, scripted response, route retry, or outer cleanup is bypassed.

Boundaries.Name: native-string-admission
Boundaries.Contract: Immediate admission returns the original string source and its native cancellation, status and continuation behavior. The source owns final inspection through response cleanup and caller release, independently of metric selection at admission.

Boundaries.Name: native-bytes-admission
Boundaries.Contract: Immediate admission returns the original byte source. It retains native cancellation, FIFO receive lifetime and final publication after cleanup, including listeners enabled while pending.

Boundaries.Name: native-converted-admission
Boundaries.Contract: Immediate admission returns the original converted source. Conversion remains deferred to caller inspection; final failure publication follows conversion, response disposal and caller reference release. Transfers retain existing response ownership semantics.
